components.responsibility: Android OS-protected storage of the opaque same-user MIRA client credential using Android Keystore and authenticated no-backup ciphertext.
components.why_separate: Native credential protection is a client security boundary below transport and UI; it must not absorb provider credentials, canonical state, offline synchronization, or server-side revocation authority.

components.responsibility: Android replay-safe encrypted local state for exact provider-neutral API command intents, acknowledgement replay suppression, nonauthoritative canonical snapshots, and opaque reconnect cursor compare-and-set state.
components.why_separate: Local offline persistence is a client synchronization primitive below transport and UI. It stages exact API intent and verified-readback cache material without becoming network transport, conflict policy, provider authority, or canonical state.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral Android reconnect orchestration enforcing exact queued-command replay, verified terminal acknowledgement, verified canonical snapshot persistence, and snapshot-before-cursor progression.
components.why_separate: Reconnect orchestration coordinates durable local state with authenticated transports without owning provider OAuth, network implementation, canonical authority, conflict UI, or provider connection UX.

components.responsibility: Default-Personal Android mapping between exact API command intent / reconnect change pages and the MIRA Google Workspace Commands and verified Changes row protocols through an injected authorized Sheets gateway.
components.why_separate: The row protocol validates transport evidence without owning OAuth UI, account selection, provider identifiers, network client lifecycle, canonical authority, or local persistence; concrete Google SDK/network behavior remains outside core.

components.responsibility: Token-free Android binding and revalidation of one provider-selected MIRA Personal Google Sheet, including exact clean-starter metadata checks and honest direct-versus-shared-writer readiness state.
components.why_separate: Google-specific file identity and readiness verification belongs in the replaceable provider module rather than provider-neutral core and remains separate from consent UI, raw transport semantics, canonical mutation, and local reconnect state.

components.responsibility: Android Google Identity Services consent, provider-owned mobile Picker handoff and revocation using only drive.file, with exact one-file grant parsing.
components.why_separate: Google SDK authorization/revocation is provider-specific and must remain outside provider-neutral core; it never persists tokens, validates canonical MIRA state, or gains generic Drive authority.

components.responsibility: Least-authority Google Drive/Sheets REST bridge for selected-file metadata, bounded MIRA verification/transport reads, and the Commands-only append surface consumed by GoogleWorkspaceTransport.
components.why_separate: Provider HTTP/network behavior, provider IDs and error normalization stay in the replaceable Google module so core remains incapable of acquiring generic Drive or Sheets authority.
